meta.name: codebase-design
meta.description: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计深度模块的共享词汇，改善接口与可测试性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在设计或改进模块接口，寻找深化机会
copy.tagline_en: Design deep modules with shared vocabulary for better interfaces and testability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing or improving module interfaces and seeking deepening opportunities

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会用一套固定术语（如模块、接口、深度）帮你设计或改进代码模块，让接口更小、功能更强、更容易测试。
howto.when: 当你询问如何设计或改进一个模块的接口、寻找代码的拆分点、或想让代码更易测试时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个订单处理模块的接口，要深模块。
say.note: Claude 会按深模块原则给出小接口、多实现的方案。

say.text: 这个函数接口太浅了，怎么加深？
say.note: Claude 会分析并建议减少方法或简化参数。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses a fixed vocabulary (module, interface, depth) to help you design or improve code modules, making interfaces smaller, behavior richer, and testing easier.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about designing or improving a module's interface, finding a seam, or making code more testable.

say_en.text: Help me design an interface for an order processing module, make it deep.
say_en.note: Claude will propose a small interface with lots of hidden behavior.

say_en.text: This function's interface is too shallow, how to deepen it?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and suggest reducing methods or simplifying params.
